item.tib: dbal chen ge khod gsang drag gi yang snying sgrub pa'i gzhung
item.coloph: rig gsum mgon po thugs rje can/ srung zlog bsad gsum spyi dril gyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di/ khri min lcags kyi bya rus mdzad/ de nas stag sna sad spungs phyin chad nas/ dran pa nam mkha' yan chad du/ gcig nas gcig gi snyan du brgyud/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob/ grub rtags mthu rtsal bsam las 'das/ thang cig las kyi dbang gis nub/ de dus dran pa nam mkha' yis/ dkar chag yi ge ris su btab/ mi rul gser dang rtsi yis byug zang zang lha brag gter du sbas/ yab sras lnga la bcol gtad byas/ phyi rabs dar ba'i smon lam btab/ de nas sa pho rta yi lo/ dran pa sku yi sprul pa ni/ khyung rgod rtsal gyis gter nas bton/ bru ston 'dul ba la bcol gtad mdzad/ bal yo mtshams pa la dngos grub du bab/ de nas rim par brgyud//
